baseline_B2: Same Yang 61-marker layout and same 500-trial dataset; not counted twice.
sampling: Revised first-PDF funnel R(hmax): 10x10 inclusive +/-0.45 m camera grid; 5 repetitions; camera height 2 m; zero initial attitude/velocity.

metric_definitions.A: Per-trial fraction with at least one complete marker and minimum projected edge >=40 px, from GT projection; then equal trial mean.
metric_definitions.E: Per-trial sqrt(mean(||estimated camera position - GT camera position||^2)) on valid poses, then equal trial mean/sample std; cm.
metric_definitions.d: GT camera-to-pad horizontal distance at vision-height termination; cm; touchdown events only.
metric_definitions.S: Vision-height touchdown with lateral error <=10 cm; percentage of all trials.
metric_definitions.missing_poses: Excluded from RMSE, included in pose availability denominator.
metric_definitions.projection: Actual camera attitude; all four corners inside image; conservative minimum of the four projected edge lengths.
metric_definitions.termination: vision camera height threshold, not physical ground contact

Experimental fixed-threshold CUDA detector; same-image CPU/GPU equivalence failed for B3 on both local OpenCV 4.13.0 and SDK OpenCV 4.14.0.
B3 and baseline are source-figure reconstructions uniformly scaled to 0.7 m, not supplied metric CAD.

Camera XY at camera-height-defined funnel width: 180 boundary-start trials per configuration exceed the region; maximum camera excess is 1.53035 cm. Body XY against that same camera-height width has a smaller maximum excess of 0.55763 cm. Neither comparison certifies the paper body-height funnel condition.
Nominal rendering, frozen dynamics parameters and deterministic initial conditions; five repetitions do not introduce stochastic perturbations.
Geometric 40 px availability is separate from decoded/valid-pose availability; the reused PnP accepts mean marker sides down to 12 px.
